descriptionHtml:
Bug B19 · excluded (All tickets still in progress / ready for PR (not counted, Quinn 2026-10-14)) · was P1

Retention / purge is not implemented per UAT 3.6: 13-hour Important Points and 37-hour tasks, handoffs and vitals are still there; nothing is purged unless a device opens the app; past 500 patients some charts are skipped

Tickets: TFA-94699 in progress · counts as a QA bug: no (ticket in progress) · found on: local

Note: One root cause behind 19 cases; the windows themselves are decision D6

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-04/S01, OAT-04/S04, OAT-04/S07, OAT-04/S08, OAT-04/S11, OAT-04/S14, OAT-04/S17, OAT-04/S23, OAT-04/S24, OAT-04/S26, OAT-04/S27, TC-10/S21, TC-11/S25, TC-12/S05, TC-13/S15, TC-13/S16, TC-12/S29, TC-13/S29

Approach · OAT-04 Data Retention · S15 No copy survives: after the 37 h purge, search every field and table for the aged values

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U11 Live patient data never survives past its window: once an item clears, no copy of it remains anywhere live (other fields of the chart, dated histories, the patient-list row, handoffs, drafts). … (UAT OAT-04 Expected 2; UAT 3.7 (retention claim)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U1 Deletion is a hard delete, not a hidden flag: every record that clears (at its window, or when a patient or account is deleted) is gone from the database, queryable as gone, and is not merely hidden … (UAT OAT-04; UAT OAT-04 step 2; TFA-94699 AC 1; TFA-92568 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress; TFA-92568 in progress
  • U16 The Hospital course timeline keeps only today's and yesterday's lines (server days); older lines are deleted from the chart, not only hidden. (UAT 3.6 (course timeline and prior transcripts show today and yesterday only); UAT 3.7 (retention claim); TFA-94699 snapshot (TFA-92589 / PR #91 hands the purge of older lines to this ticket)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Hospital patient seeded with a unique marker in every place patient data can sit: vitals and labs and their dated histories, medication rows and medication events, the note, its billing suggestion and addendum, the carry-forward line, the encounter transcript, a course timeline line dated three days ago, a handoff tha …

When The purge runs; the patient's document, its patient-list row, handoffs, quickDictationDrafts and unassignedRoundingItems are dumped with admin access and searched for the markers

Then No marker of an item past its window is found anywhere; markers in items whose window is undecided (Q6, Q10) are listed separately

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT OAT-04 Expected 2 ('live patient data never survives past its window') and the 3.7 retention claim: a marker found for an item whose window has passed = Fail (RET-COURSE-912 per U16); RET-TX-909 / RET-NOTE-905 at 37 h are judged per Q4; roster, background and the other Q6 / Q10 items are reported as 'needs a decision', not judged

Where it ran: local retention (clock moved to check retention); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: manual (blocked)

S15 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92568 in progress; TFA-92589 ready for qa; TFA-94699 in progress

37 h after everything was recorded the patient's old vitals and labs are still in the dated grids, the full handoff text is still readable, and a course line from 3 days ago is still stored.

Evidence: allure 9c445faf-…-result.json; retention lane, marker search over the admin dump. 1 check passes, 4 fail, all known: K6 (vitalsHistory/labsHistory, admissionSummary.course) and K3 (handoffs). Recorded against Q4/Q6/Q10: the transcript (per-stay policy), medicationEvents, billingSuggestion, addendum, nextPreRoundSummary and Quick Dictation compartments still hold the marker.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane retention.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: retention.

UAT item: OAT-04 Data Retention · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-04/S15

Tickets: TFA-92568 Phase 4: Make it safe for real patients (in progress); TFA-92589 Course Timeline (ready for qa); TFA-94699 Data Retention & Purge (in progress)

New local lane retention: status failed in retention/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (retention/plan.json, automatable: yes): API spec: one chart with a unique marker in every place (vitals + vitalsHistory, labs + labsHistory, med row, medicationEvents, note, billing, addendum, carry-forward, encounter + transcript, course line 3 days old, handoff text, Quick Dictation compartment assigned through quickDictation:assign); every clock aged 37 h by the helper; purge; marker search over the admin dump of all tables. Q4/Q6/Q10 markers recorded. The helper's days option now also moves transcriptDate (whole calendar days in the browser's zone; exact for this single 37 h move of a today stamp), and the vitalsHistory / labsHistory dates the same way. — Raw admin dump covers every table that holds patient text.
